verified_working_methods.notes: Direct curl and yt-dlp both FAIL from datacenter IP: xiaohongshu.com serves a fake 'page not found' (小红书 - 你访问的页面不见了) HTML to plain curl/requests/yt-dlp, and yt-dlp's XiaoHongShu extractor reports 'No video formats found'. XHS-Downloader bypasses this via curl_cffi TLS/JA3 fingerprint impersonation (impersonate='chrome146') + the edith.xiaohongshu.com /api/sns/web/v1/feed endpoint with its own X-s/X-t signature. Works for public notes WITHOUT a cookie from a datacenter IP. Video notes download as .mp4 from sns-video-qc.xhscdn.com via the same pipeline (video_download=True).
